questions.question: How many meetings take place worldwide each year?
questions.answer: 1 billion - Over 55 million meetings happen every week, adding up to more than 1 billion per year.

questions.question: What percentage of employees spend up to one-third of their workweek in meetings?
questions.answer: 83.13% - The majority of employees spend up to one-third of their workweek in meetings.

questions.question: What percentage of an organization's time is spent in meetings on average?
questions.answer: 15% - On average, organizations dedicate 15% of their time to meetings.

questions.question: How much money is estimated to be lost annually due to unproductive meetings?
questions.answer: $37 billion - Unproductive meetings cost organizations an estimated $37 billion per year.

questions.question: What percentage of meetings are considered productive?
questions.answer: 30% - Only 30% of meetings are considered productive.

questions.question: What percentage of workplace meetings actively use an agenda?
questions.answer: 37% - Only 37% of workplace meetings actively use an agenda.

questions.question: What percentage of professionals lose time weekly due to canceled or unnecessary meetings?
questions.answer: 71% - A large majority of professionals lose time every week due to canceled or unnecessary meetings.

questions.question: By how much did the average meeting length increase every year between 2000 and 2020?
questions.answer: 8%-10% - The average meeting length increased by 8% to 10% annually between 2000 and 2020.

questions.question: What percentage of remote workers believe most meetings could have been an email?
questions.answer: 55% - More than half of remote workers think that most meetings could have been an email.

questions.question: What percentage of virtual meetings do executives consider failures?
questions.answer: 67% - Executives consider more than 67% of virtual meetings to be failures.

questions.question: What percentage of workers multitask during virtual meetings?
questions.answer: 92% - A staggering 92% of workers admit to multitasking during virtual meetings.

questions.question: What percentage of workers believe virtual meetings are less stressful?
questions.answer: 70% - 70% of workers feel that virtual meetings are less stressful.

questions.question: Which group experiences Zoom fatigue more often?
questions.answer: Introverts - 58% of introverts experience Zoom fatigue, compared to 40% of extroverts.
